You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To buy cast iron pans, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Research the difference between enameled and bare cast iron (45 minutes)
Step 2. Read online reviews for top-rated skillet brands (1 hour)
Step 3. Measure the dimensions of your stovetop burners (5 minutes)
Step 4. Decide on the ideal pan diameter for your needs (10 minutes)
Step 5. Drive to the local kitchen supply store (20 minutes)
Step 6. Check the physical weight of the pans on the shelf (10 minutes)
Step 7. Compare prices between different retailers (30 minutes)
Step 8. Look for seasonal discount codes or coupons (15 minutes)
Step 9. Verify the manufacturer's warranty details (15 minutes)
Step 10. Check if the store has the specific model in stock (5 minutes)
Step 11. Read about the benefits of a helper handle (10 minutes)
Step 12. Determine if you prefer a pre-seasoned or unseasoned pan (20 minutes)
Step 13. Look at various wall-mounting rack options (40 minutes)
Step 14. Place the selected pan in your shopping cart (2 minutes)
Step 15. Sign up for the store's loyalty rewards program (5 minutes)
Step 16. Ask a store associate about the return policy (5 minutes)
Step 17. Calculate the total budget including shipping costs (10 minutes)
Step 18. Select a high-quality chainmail scrubber for cleaning (10 minutes)
Step 19. Choose a bottle of specialized seasoning oil (5 minutes)
Step 20. Confirm the pan is induction-compatible (5 minutes)
Step 21. Set aside the necessary funds in your checking account (5 minutes)
Step 22. Watch a video on how to identify casting flaws (15 minutes)
Step 23. Research the heat retention properties of different thicknesses (30 minutes)
Step 24. Look for a heat-resistant silicone handle cover (10 minutes)
Step 25. Evaluate the storage space in your kitchen cabinets (10 minutes)
Step 26. Consult a professional chef's blog for recommendations (20 minutes)
Step 27. Check the weight limits of your kitchen shelving (15 minutes)
Step 28. Compare the ergonomics of various handle designs (25 minutes)
Step 29. Purchase a stiff-bristled cleaning brush (10 minutes)
Step 30. Look for a matching glass or iron lid (15 minutes)
Step 31. Wait for a holiday sales event to begin (4 days)
Step 32. Download a price tracking app for kitchenware (5 minutes)
Step 33. Inspect the smoothness of the pan's cooking surface (10 minutes)
Step 34. Measure the height clearance of your oven racks (5 minutes)
Step 35. Finalize the choice of brand and model (30 minutes)
Step 36. Select a sturdy spatula safe for cast iron (10 minutes)
Step 37. Read the care and maintenance instructions (20 minutes)
Step 38. Enter your credit card and shipping information (5 minutes)
Step 39. Identify the specific recipes you want to cook (1 hour)
Step 40. Double-check the store's operating hours (2 minutes)
